text:
omar: Quick sync — vendor roadmap triage for Q3 releases. Needed: one consolidated list of shifting dates + marketplace announce constraints. TL;DR: H100 supplier pushed earliest node by 3 weeks, MI300 early-access in APAC may slip, Gaudi driver v2 changes require SI patches.
jenna: thx. can we get concrete cutoffs for marketplace listing? cloud marketplace needs final SKU and driver compat 2 weeks before announce.
rachel: @jenna confirmed — for H100 the vendor PR notes say GA build arrives ~2024-08-15 (estimate). If that holds, marketplace cutover would be ~2024-08-01 to allow e2e tests.
paul: timeline risk: H100 thermal firmware still in test. If firmware lands late, we should plan fallback to B200-compatible quantized variant for hosted customers.
sasha: SI note: Gaudi driver v2 introduces ABI change. Integrators will need to rebuild inference container images. Suggest 2-week integrator dry run window once driver RC publishes.
omar: action item list:
- confirm vendor GA dates (OMAR) by EOD tomorrow
- marketplace SKU freeze + test window (JENNA) target 2024-08-01
- SI dry run plan for Gaudi (SASHA) target 2024-07-20
- fallback model mapping for H100 delays (PAUL/RACHEL)
jenna: add embargo constraints: marketing needs 10 business days notice for joint announcement + press embargo lead. Keep that in timeline. :exclamation:
rachel: quick compatibility matrix (draft):
```
H100 -> preferred: h100-rtx, fallback: b200-q8
H200 -> preferred: h200-prod
MI300 -> preferred: mi300-18b, note: APAC early-access window 2024-07-25 -> 2024-08-05
Gaudi -> requires driver v2, SI rebuild
```
omar: thanks. also vendor update from partner-bot:
partner-bot: Vendor update: H100 supplier reports microcode validation extended by 14 days, MI300 early-access window unchanged, Gaudi driver v2 RC expected next Tue. (link: https://vendor.example/sync)
paul: so practical plan: if H100 slips past 2024-08-10, we gate marketplace announce and instead run a soft-launch to selected customers. Anyone opposed?
jenna: agree. soft-launch: limit to beta customers + update docs. marketing runbook will need copy for fallback messaging.
sasha: SI impact: if Gaudi RC arrives next Tue, we start rebuild Friday, dry-run Mon 2024-07-22. That's tight but doable if integrators prioritize. Need heads-up to integrator leads now.
omar: I'll ping integrator leads after this thread. Also flagging capacity: Dedicated pools may need temporary reallocation to B200 to keep latency SLOs if H100 delayed. Eng infra FYI.
rachel: sample rollout checklist + dates:
- 2024-07-15: vendor GA confirm
- 2024-07-20: SI dry-run starts (Gaudi)
- 2024-07-25: MI300 APAC early-access begins
- 2024-08-01: marketplace SKU freeze & e2e test window
- 2024-08-15: expected H100 GA (vendor est)
omar: ok. last Qs: any regulatory or region pauses we should note? EU data residency for private deploys might expand testing window by 1 week.
paul: noted. I'll add EU residency test plan to the marketplace docs.
jenna: thanks all. I'll assemble a single timeline doc and publish to partners drive. :thumbsup:
omar: perfect. closing — will update after vendor confirms.
